decisive_items: a distended gallbladder with poor delineation of the posterior wall, appearing large, solid, and heterogeneous with posterior dense shadowing and calcific components
a 10-cm calcified gallbladder wall invading liver segments 4 and 5
multiple pulmonary nodules consistent with metastatic disease (T4 N1 M1)
response.rationale: The combination of a distended gallbladder with a large, solid, and heterogeneous mass, along with a calcified gallbladder wall invading the liver and lymph node enlargement, is highly suggestive of gallbladder cancer with metastatic disease.

rejected.why: Normal common bile duct caliber and lack of intrahepatic duct dilatation make cholangiocarcinoma less likely.
